profiles.A: Loopback HTTP + real PG + ProductionRuntime; original one-span evidence; synthetic model/token accounting, branch hits and streamed provider response, no injected sleep
profiles.B: Same as A, with real local Qdrant dense/BM25 HTTP branches and three original points (one valid, two out of scope); synthetic 2D embedding/reranker/tokenization; NOT real E5/BGE or corpus performance
profiles.C: Inclusive monotonic timing of unchanged M2 _record calls (lock, SQL, flush, commit); event INSERT cursor time separately. Atomic publication event excluded from _record timing. No event suppression or M1/M2 A/B

workload: Each independent conversation has one untimed accepted documentary seed Turn with exact current-question entity provenance, then one measured documentary Turn with bounded nonempty history and a structurally guarded completion-only rewrite inheriting the receiver. Same shared KB/version; stable logical identities and unique keys. Measured workflow POST + authorized result GET + Trace GET. POST latency also reported separately. Untimed seeding uses five workers.
measured_question: What does the receiver do with a damaged message?
scheduler: Finite closed-loop workers, all operations recorded; enqueue-to-finish also retained. Not an open-loop capacity/SLO test; offered arrival rate is response-dependent.
percentile: Nearest rank ceil(p*n), all attempted workflow termination latencies including failure/timeout; success-only separately. No p99 below 1000 samples.
resource_process_identity: Actual Python API worker; follow the Windows venv launcher's module-matching child. v1 sampled only that launcher; its API CPU/RSS facts are invalid. v1 diagnostic receipts preserved, v2 frozen again before any product change and used for all final comparisons.
extension_policy: Do not extend beyond 20 in this contract. Every comparison uses identical contract and harness hashes. Correctness failure invalidates that run.
